standard-dialogue.npc: Hey there [player name], Do you want that shopping list now?

standard-dialogue.player: It depends, what do I get out of it again?

standard-dialogue.npc: I've got this Death Talisman I could give you in return. You'll need it if you want to get into the altar.

options.text: Okay sure thing, what do you need?

steps.player: Ok sure thing, what do you need?

steps.npc: You'd better take this list, we need everything on it! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.

options.text: Hmm no thanks, I'm not interested.

steps.player: Hmm no thanks, I'm not interested.

after-being-given-item-list.npc: Hi again, how're you doing with those items we need?

options.text: I've got some of them with me.

steps.player: I've got some of them with me.

steps.npc: Great, can I take everything I need?

steps.player: Yeah sure.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have any items with them:

steps.npc: Doesn't look like you do to me.

steps.text: If the player still has items on the list:

steps.npc: Thanks, I've updated your list for you.

steps.text: If the player gives him the last item:

steps.npc: Great, thank you so much for getting all that for us! Please take this Death Talisman as a reward.
Anytime you want another one of those Talismans come see me and I'll sort you out with another list.

steps.player: I'd rather you didn't.

steps.npc: I see you've got the [item], can I have it please?

steps.npc: Looks like you're carrying enough stuff at the moment.

options.text: What do you need all this stuff for?

steps.player: What do you need all this stuff for?

steps.npc: Oh well, we don't get many deliveries down here, so it's supplies mostly...

options.condition: If the player has not yet given the ticket:

steps.player: What about the [ticket]?

steps.npc: Well you see.. Umm... We don't really get much chance to.. Er.. Go out or anything... And we'd like some of the prizes some day...

steps.player: So why didn't you ask for the prizes then?

steps.npc: Oh no, that'd just be sad.

options.text: So why do you want the [book]?
options.condition: If the player has not yet given the book:

steps.player: So why do you want the [book]?

steps.npc: Oh just some light reading, it's nice to catch up on current events occasionally.

steps.player: Current events? But it's... Oh nevermind.

options.condition: If the player has not yet given the key:

steps.player: How do you explain the [key]?

steps.npc: Ah... Um... I'm not sure how that got on the list... Can we have it anyway?

steps.player: Right, why do I get the feeling I shouldn't?

steps.npc: Pretty please with a Blood Talisman on top?!

steps.player: A Blood Talisman?!

steps.npc: Oops! I meant 'Death Talisman'!

options.text: Yeah, right, all those are just 'supplies'.

options.text: No, I'd better get looking for them.
